execution_requires: AHC closeout plus a frozen execution protocol with model candidates, hyperparameter budget, seeds and selection rules

primary_target.meaning: computed reference; PM emulation, not independently measured ET

secondary_reference.meaning: computed SIAR reference; not an input feature
secondary_reference.policy: existing v1 reference eligibility including zero

test_status: retrospective_locked; full-history baselines were already inspected and AHC may already have published this period
prospective_confirmation: requires a later dataset and protocol locked before observing its targets or errors
split_policy: inclusive global calendar cuts shared by all stations; no random split; publish station/date assignments and SHA256

derived_features.Ra_mj_m2_day: versioned solar geometry from date and latitude

missing_policy: initial complete-case eligibility independently per feature family; no target or meteorological imputation; preserve all dataset rows

station_policy.primary_population: stations with TRAIN support and VALIDATION/TEST presence; freeze availability-based list before fitting
station_policy.IB101: short 2008-2009 series; no invented validation/test or robust AHC

preprocessing.normalization: TRAIN-only parameters stored and frozen; optional for tree models
preprocessing.zero_variance: explicit policy, no division by zero
preprocessing.future_imputation_variants: new experiment, TRAIN-only fitting and declared missing indicators
prohibited: global dropna shared across feature families

future_model_order: random forest or extra trees if justified

selection.budget: must be locked in execution protocol before fitting

ahc_comparison.primary: PM unchanged plus HS/HG-Rs/Valiantzas original and annual AHC_VALIDATED
ahc_comparison.secondary: only variants selected on VALIDATION and frozen before TEST

evaluation.season_policy: northern DJF/MAM/JJA/SON; December assigned to following season-year; never merge splits
evaluation.negative_predictions: retain and flag; no silent clipping
